scripts.build: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core build && npm run --workspace streamfusion build
scripts.dist: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core build && npm run --workspace streamfusion dist
scripts.dist:win: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core build && npm run --workspace streamfusion dist:win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core build && npm run --workspace streamfusion dist:mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core build && npm run --workspace streamfusion dist:linux
scripts.install:dependencies: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run lint:dependencies && npm run lint:release-age && npm run audit:signatures && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run rebuild:dependencies
scripts.rebuild:dependencies: npm rebuild better-sqlite3 electron-winstaller esbuild ffmpeg-static fsevents unrs-resolver workerd --ignore-scripts=false && npm run --workspace streamfusion install:electron
scripts.lint: npm run lint:dependencies && npm run lint:lockfile && npm run lint:core-imports && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core lint && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/mobile lint && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/integration-relay lint && npm run --workspace streamfusion lint
scripts.lint:lockfile: eslint --config eslint.lockfile.config.mjs package-lock.json package.json "apps/*/package.json" "packages/*/package.json" && npm run lint:release-age
scripts.test: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core test && npm run test:evidence && node --test scripts/start-picker.test.mjs && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/mobile test && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/integration-relay test && npm run --workspace streamfusion test && npm run --workspace streamfusion-worker test
scripts.test:all: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core test && npm run test:evidence && node --test scripts/start-picker.test.mjs && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/mobile test && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/integration-relay test && npm run --workspace streamfusion test:all && npm run --workspace streamfusion-worker test
scripts.typecheck: npm run --workspace @streamfusion/core typecheck && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/mobile typecheck && npm run --workspace @streamfusion/integration-relay typecheck && npm run --workspace streamfusion typecheck && npm run --workspace streamfusion-worker typecheck
